_note: MERCHANT_URL says WHERE the measurement client sends requests — it is not an identity (see section 1 in ../../docs/IDENTITY.md).
_note_hostname: A hostname is recommended instead of an IP address (e.g. http://x402.your-domain.example:3300): when the server's IP changes, the configuration does not need to be changed. You can also set the value with the MERCHANT_URL environment variable, which takes precedence over this file: MERCHANT_URL=http://x402.your-domain.example:3300 npm run mock
_note_wireshark: For a capture in Wireshark use http:// (without TLS), otherwise the 402 and X-Payment are not visible in the capture. The merged flow has exactly TWO request/response pairs on the wire.
